LR_selection: lowest mean final FULL2000 local RMSE across two seeds of A2/A3/A4; tie favors lower LR
A5: same selected LR/head and seeds, disable element/bond optimization, keep effective geometry loss coefficient equal to corresponding multi-task group

gate.denoising: both selected multi-task seeds strictly below refitted FULL2000 lookup RMSE
gate.gradient: mean final20 TRAIN batch fractions >=0.10 for each seed, all backbone parameters; fixed weights only
gate.other_tasks: masked element accuracy and bond order accuracy each >= matched A0 seed
gate.cost: measured throughput and VRAM reported; projected full epoch including observed validation/checkpoint overhead <=15GPUh

formal_convergence.aggregate: mean of each pair of seeds
formal_convergence.downstream: B3 improvement must exceed both abs(B1seed0-B1seed1) and abs(B3seed0-B3seed1) to count unconverged
